### P2 "VoxelMeshRenderer.1" (Render Pipeline) · Vertex

```glsl
// Reverse-Z (score project rule, CameraMath.hpp setReverseZPerspective): near -> NDC +1, far -> -1,
// paired with the engine's GREATER depth compare and 0.0 depth clear. A standard GL projection here
// makes the farthest fragment win.
mat4 buildPerspective(float fovDeg, float aspect, float near, float far)
{
  float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fovDeg) * 0.5);
  float nf = 1.0 / (near - far);
  return mat4(
    f / aspect, 0.0, 0.0,                   0.0,
    0.0,        f,   0.0,                   0.0,
    0.0,        0.0, -(far + near) * nf,    -1.0,
    0.0,        0.0, -2.0 * far * near * nf, 0.0
  );
}

mat4 buildLookAt(vec3 eye, vec3 target, vec3 up)
{
  vec3 f = normalize(target - eye);
  vec3 s = normalize(cross(f, up));
  vec3 u = cross(s, f);
// … 33 more lines
```

### P2 "VoxelMeshRenderer.1" (Render Pipeline) · Fragment

description: Renders voxel meshes (from Voxel Loader in Mesh mode) with palette-based coloring and Minecraft-style flat face shading. Expects pre-built triangle mesh with position, normal, and material_id per vertex. Pipeline: Voxel Loader (Mesh mode) → VoxelMeshRenderer. Its own camera: cameraPos looking at lookAt.; categories: Renderer, 3D, Voxel; inputs: lightDir:point3D=[0.3,0.8,0.5], ambient:float=0.3, faceShading:float=0.15, cameraPos:point3D=[3,4,3], lookAt:point3D=[0,0,0], fov:float=60, nearPlane:float=0.01, farPlane:float=500

```glsl
void main()
{
  vec3 N = normalize(v_normal);
  vec3 L = normalize(lightDir);

  // Diffuse lighting
  float NdotL = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
  float lighting = ambient + (1.0 - ambient) * NdotL;

  // Per-face shading variation (Minecraft-style)
  float faceModifier = 1.0;
  vec3 absN = abs(N);
  if(absN.y > 0.5)
    faceModifier = N.y > 0.0 ? 1.0 + faceShading : 1.0 - faceShading;
  else if(absN.x > 0.5)
    faceModifier = 1.0 - faceShading * 0.5;

  vec3 finalColor = v_color.rgb * lighting * faceModifier;

  isf_FragColor = vec4(finalColor, v_color.a);
}
```

### P3 "Depth _ Color Outlines" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: Combined depth + luminance edge detection. Runs Sobel on both the scene depth and the scene luminance, then takes the weighted max. Catches edges that depth misses (internal texture detail) AND that colour misses (same-coloured objects in front of each other). Outlines are painted over the input, so they also show where a silhouette meets a transparent sky.; categories: Post-process, Outlines; inputs: inputImage:image, camera:uniform, edgeColor:color=[1,1,1,1], depthWeight:float=1, colorWeight:float=0.5, depthThreshold:float=0.1, colorThreshold:float=0.15, edgeSoftness:float=0.05, edgeOpacity:float=1, dimScene:float=0

### P4 "Tonemap" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: Tone mapping for HDRtoSDR conversion. Expects linear-light input where 1.0 = SDR reference white and values > 1.0 are HDR highlights.
